name: io.github.noahowsh/dunkapi
title: DunkAPI
description: NBA, WNBA and college basketball data: play-by-play, shot locations, box scores, odds. REST and MCP.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Your DunkAPI API key. Get a free key with 500 credits at dunkapi.com/signup

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: Team ids, abbreviations and colours for a season

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Games with scores by season, date, range or team

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming games with the median line across sportsbooks

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Standings from every final game: overall, conference, home, away, last 10

tools.name: get_injuries
tools.description: The latest injury report: status, injury and expected return (NBA, WNBA)

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: One game: both box scores, every player's line, each book's line, win probability

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Profile, per-season averages and shooting splits, last 10 games

tools.name: get_leaders
tools.description: Season leaders per game, by percentage or in total

tools.name: get_team_stats
tools.description: Pace, offensive, defensive and net rating, and the four factors

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Every sportsbook's moneyline, spread and total for a game (5) or a day (10), with results against the line

tools.name: get_plays
tools.description: Play-by-play with shot locations, zones, expected points and win probability

tools.name: get_shot_chart
tools.description: Shot profile by zone for a player, team or defence, with every shot's x/y

tools.name: get_line_movement
tools.description: Snapshots of each sportsbook's line before tip-off

tools.name: get_player_props
tools.description: Player prop lines by sportsbook, opening and closing

tools.name: get_prop_history
tools.description: A player's prop lines against the result, game by game
